sources.note: DGIST International Graduate admissions - Graduate Scholarship page (the record's official_source_url). Read in full.

DGIST International Graduate admissions - Application page with the 'Admission Timeline' table for 2027 Spring (1st/2nd/3rd) and 2026 Fall. Read in full because the scholarship page itself publishes no deadline.

awarding_body.detail: Both pages are on DGIST's own domain (dgist.ac.kr) under the site heading 'DGIST Internaional Graduate', with the admissions office contact admission@dgist.ac.kr and footer 'COPYRIGHT 2024 DGIST. ALL RIGHTS RESERVED.' The scholarship page describes the Government Scholarship as 'funded by the Korean government' and administered through DGIST graduate admission. This is the awarding body's own page, not an aggregator.
awarding_body.quote: A student receiving scholarship benefits funded by the Korean government.

deadline.detail: The Application page's Admission Timeline table lists the 2027 Spring 3rd round online application period as '26.11.5.(Thu)~11.19.(Thu)' in Korean Standard Time, which is exactly the record's 5-19 November 2026. Timing note: at check time (12 Oct 2026) no window is literally open - Spring 2nd closed 10 Sep 2026 and Spring 3rd opens 5 Nov 2026 - so the recorded deadline is the next round of the in-progress 2027 Spring cycle. The page also warns: 'The above schedule is subject to change depending on the academic year (all dates are based on Korean Standard Time)'.

eligibility.detail: The page confirms the record's core eligibility mechanism verbatim: admission to the graduate school automatically registers the student to the scholarship with no additional process. The Government Scholarship's 'Available Departments' list matches the record's 'listed departments' (Physics and Chemistry; Electrical Engineering and Computer Science; Robotics and Mechatronics Engineering; Energy Science and Engineering; Brain Sciences; New Biology; Artificial Intelligence Major in Interdisciplinary Studies; Artificial Intelligence; Biomedical Science&Engineering; Quantum Information Science). The word 'international' is not stated on the scholarship page itself, but the page is DGIST's international graduate admissions site and the housing section addresses 'DGIST international students'; the record's claim is consistent with the page.
eligibility.quote: Admission to the graduate school guarantees automatic registration to scholarship without any additional process

funding.detail: The Government Scholarship provides 'Full tuition coverage' (page notes tuition fees vary by department and major) plus a stipend: 'Master's program : A minimum of 9.6 million KRW annually plus additional incentives' and 'PhD program : A minimum of 14.04 million KRW annually plus additional incentives', with incentives varying by research performance. Housing (Biseul Village) is available at cost (single 220,000 / double 170,000 / married apartment 290,000 KRW per month), not included. This matches the record's funding_type 'Tuition Fee Waiver, Stipend'; it is not a fully funded living-cost award.
funding.quote: Master's program : A minimum of 9.6 million KRW annually plus additional incentives

degree_levels.detail: The scholarship page offers the Government Scholarship for both Master's and PhD programs, listing separate stipend rates for each. Matches the record's 'Master's, PhD'.
degree_levels.quote: PhD program : A minimum of 14.04 million KRW annually plus additional incentives

recommended_field_updates.deadline_text: DGIST 2027 Spring 3rd round online application period: 5 November 2026 to 19 November 2026 (Korean Standard Time)
recommended_field_updates.verification_notes: Both DGIST pages live and current as of 12 Oct 2026. On the next re-check, confirm the Spring 3rd window actually opens on 5 Nov 2026, since the site warns the schedule is subject to change. Be aware DGIST lists a second scholarship track on the same page ('DGIST Scholarship', stipend a minimum of 15M KRW Master's / 22M KRW PhD but tuition payment required) - this record covers the Government Scholarship only. Tuition fee levels vary by department and major; amounts should be confirmed with the department.
